The Roubic Mayfield Story

Working Mayfield's Canopy Since 1982

Roubic Tree & Landscape has cared for trees across Mayfield since 1982 — the same year {{global.owner_name}}'s family founded the company in Auburn Township. Mayfield sits in the Hillcrest area of northeast Cuyahoga County, a residential village whose streets carry the heritage oaks, mature maples, original-growth pines, and EAB-threatened ash that define this stretch of the eastern corridor.

The species mix here shapes the work: preservation pruning where a canopy is worth keeping, and safe removal where emerald ash borer or storm damage has taken a tree past saving. Every Mayfield job is owner-supervised, cut to ANSI A300 standards, and handled with our own owned equipment fleet — no subcontracting, no rental gaps.

The tree care has to fit the place. Mayfield homeowners want a crew that knows the difference between a tree worth saving and one that needs to come down — and treats the property like it's ours. {{global.owner_name}} · Owner

Permits handled for you. Mayfield generally follows standard county rules for removals on private property, and Roubic confirms any permit or zoning requirement as part of every free estimate.

Common Mayfield Questions

Mayfield Tree Service FAQ

Six things Mayfield homeowners want to know before booking.

Do you serve Mayfield, OH?
Yes. Mayfield is part of Roubic Tree & Landscape's Tier 3 expansion service area, about 12 miles from our Auburn Township yard, and we've cared for trees here since 1982. Call {{global.phone}} for a free estimate.
How quickly can Roubic respond in Mayfield?
As a Tier 3 market, Mayfield gets scheduled response with a brief mobilization premium on smaller jobs. For 24/7 storm emergencies, our crew dispatches immediately from Auburn Township and aims to be on-site within 2–4 hours.
Do I need a permit to remove a tree in Mayfield?
Generally no — Mayfield follows standard county rules for tree removal on private property. Large-scale clearing can trigger zoning review. Roubic confirms any permit or zoning requirement as part of every free estimate, so there's no paperwork guesswork on your end.
How much does tree removal cost in Mayfield?
There's no flat price — cost depends on tree size, species, location relative to structures, access for equipment, and whether crane rigging is needed. Every Mayfield estimate is free and quoted on-site with a confirmed price before any work begins.
Are you insured to work in Mayfield?
Yes — Roubic carries general liability and workers-comp insurance. A certificate of insurance is available on request and included in the estimate packet for jobs that require COI submission.
What tree services do you offer in Mayfield?
Our lead service in Mayfield is tree removal — standing, leaning, dead, and storm-damaged trees, including crane-assisted removals on large specimens. As a Tier 3 expansion market, additional service lines like trimming, stump grinding, and land clearing are handled case-by-case; call {{global.phone}} to ask about your property.
